about.title: About this dataset
about.description: Summary is a curated overview; Full manifest lists every field the host has published; Raw is the underlying record. Download the standalone manifest: croissant.json.

imaging.title: Imaging series
imaging.description: DICOM series in the latest version. Open one to scroll through its images and change the window, without downloading anything.
imaging.heldTitle: {count, plural, one {# image is held} other {# images are held}}
imaging.heldBody: Their headers carry values that de-identification normally removes, such as a patient id or a study date. Until a platform operator has reviewed them, only the dataset’s host and platform operators see these images. Other readers do not see them, or a series made only of them.

files.title: Files
files.description: Files in the latest version. Hosted entries are served by OCI; upstream entries are kept by the original publisher and we link to them. Hosted images can be previewed without downloading.
files.openAria: Open {file} on upstream host (opens in new tab)

versions.title: Version history
versions.description: Each published version is immutable — manifest hashes anchor downstream evaluation reports.

footer: Manifest mirrored from upstream host. <link>Back to catalog</link>.

access.gatedBody: Sign in to request access. The host reviews each request.
access.gatedForDataset: Access is gated for this dataset.
access.fileRequestBody: File a structured access request — the host reviews intent + IRB attestation against the dataset’s DUO permission terms.
access.submitted: Request submitted. The host has been notified — you’ll see the decision here and on your dashboard.
access.pendingBody: The host is reviewing your request. You’ll see the decision on your dashboard.
access.deniedBody: Your request was denied. You can file a fresh request with corrected attestations.
access.revokedBody: A previously-approved request was revoked. File a fresh request if your project now meets the revoked-condition.

bulk.noArchiveTitle: No archive available for this dataset
bulk.noArchiveBody: A bulk archive only covers files whose bytes the platform holds.
bulk.title: Download the whole dataset
bulk.includedOnly: A ZIP with the dataset’s only file{size}.
bulk.unknownSize: {count, plural, one {One of them declares no size, so the total is a lower bound.} other {# of them declare no size, so the total is a lower bound.}}
bulk.gated: {count, plural, one {# file needs approved access — request access, then download it from the list below.} other {# files need approved access — request access, then download them from the list below.}}
bulk.upstream: {count, plural, one {# file is hosted by the original publisher — open it from the list below.} other {# files are hosted by the original publisher — open them from the list below.}}
bulk.licenceNote: Every archive also contains LICENSE.txt and CITATION.txt — attribution is a condition of use, so the licence and citation travel with the bytes.
bulk.includeMetadataHint: the full manifest: provenance, licence, field definitions

preview.unavailableBody: The image could not be loaded. It may need approved access, or the signed link may have expired — try the download link instead.
